scope: Actual-source Managed never-selected cancellation is implemented and source tested. The two newly compiled/frozen scratch VMs below preserve existing real WS73 Setup6, Diagnostic held-last-reference or original complete diagnostic, and ordinary UID1000/caps0 RF20+2. The new Managed queued branch was NOT exercised by these no-policy/Diagnostic gates. Dedicated pre-selection file/alias/selection-race and Managed partial-wire/unknown cleanup acceptance remain OPEN. No surrogate Complete/Off/Ready or extra dirty-state authority is used.

management_release_source_tests.scope: actual Host predicates/TX selection/InFlight and core fast-release block; source queue/operation/lease modules and opcode/timeout constants; locks, clock scaling and surrounding transport dependencies are fixtures

descriptor_info_regression.scope: actual C register/unregister; actual Rust info structs/default, USB/serdev info and attach metadata projection; descriptor lookup/allocation/URB/types/firmware getters are dependency fixtures

held_close_scope: already-Off Diagnostic; last File reference closes, original500ms timeout is retained, joined retirement aborts one real held IN81; not immediate close abort or complete Managed cleanup
capture_scope: Real USB/HCC/DLI counterpart discovery evidence; not independent PHY capture

make_diagnostics: make[4]: 警告: jobserver 不可用: 正使用 -j1。添加 “+” 到父 make 的规则。
